The corner store has become an important part of daily life. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Eva wrote down every idea in a small notebook. What's more, guido monitored the rocket launch from control.

Eva bought a coat online because it was much cheaper. Lily always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Eva thanked Lily for the honest advice. What's more, cold water on sunburned skin creates a strange sensation.
Little by little, things began to change. At first, Eva found it difficult to keep the habit. Eva believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. In fact, street musicians fill the plaza at dusk.

People around Eva often share different ideas about the bus terminal. Eva is saving money to buy a ticket to London. On Monday evenings, Eva reviews the notes from class. Best of all, the asking price dropped twice.
What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Eva plans to study art harder this term. There are always more possibilities than we expect.
